title: British Sausage Vindaloo
description: A spicy twist on traditional British sausages, inspired by Indian cuisine.

ingredients.name: sauces, british, bangers
ingredients.notes: Choose sausages with a good balance of spices

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: Boil or bake potatoes before mashing

instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add onions and cook until they start to brown.
3. Add ginger and garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes.
4. Add British sausages and cook until browned.
5. Add diced tomatoes, chili peppers, and garam masala.
6. Stir well and bring to a simmer.
7. Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes.
8. Meanwhile, boil or bake potatoes until tender.
9. Mash potatoes with a fork or potato masher.
10. Serve British sausages with mashed potatoes and vindaloo sauce.
